item.title: Council rubbish bags now attracting other flytipping, 28th July
item.description:
Once again the council's street cleaners bags have been left here for a week+ and predictably, they are starting to attract other flytipping. Can you please stop using our street as the location for these bags, they are now there 99% of the time as it takes so long for them to be cleared that the next week's ones soon appear and the same cycle repeats.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Sladedale Road, Plumstead
